channel.title: AI Bubble Tracker
channel.description: A dated daily call on the AI cycle: is AI still accelerating, and how far ahead of it are prices?

item.title: Issue No. 7: Frenzy, in balance: AI is keeping pace with its price, for now
item.description: AI is delivering, and prices and financing are stretched to match. 5 of 16 warning signs are flashing, including AI credit stress, rising bond yields and the yield curve. The S&P 500 hasn't broken its 200-day trend, which historically is the first sign a correction is starting. AI Bubble Index 76; fundamentals 75; bubble gap 1.
